main_text.l: NV per Lethæas Eobanum Generat Hessum
Multa minans, Siculi calamos impune poetæ,
Quinetiam media Yates iam puppe sedebat,
Nesciuto, senex, inquit, sibi vindicat istum,
Istum, inquam, superum turba beata sibi.
Nam qui alijs potuit Yitam producere, certè
Infera iuris in hunc obtinet aula nihil.
TENSIS, suæ, id est, Græcæ linguæ, in A-
CRetensem patria Portum, non moribus, oras

l.i: Nec satis in Venetis natum felicitér orîs,

page.notes: Large woodcut initials N and C at the starts of the verse paragraphs; the Greek-looking word "Yates" and "Yitam" are probably long-s/Y-type initial forms, read as printed with [?] uncertainty. Line "Quum prohibes..." and "Mercurius" read as printed. Catchword "Hospitio" at the foot right. Page number not printed.
